svg.title: The ordering ecosystem - who is involved and how they interact
svg.text: The ordering ecosystem - who is involved and how they interact
A logical view, not a workflow: the parties around an order (end customer, dealer locations and users, Sparecare team, OGYS, channels, co-dealer and company) and the 14 interactions between them.

The interactions, in the order they happen
A customer needs a part the location does not have. The dealer books a customer back order (CBO); OGYS adds CBO to the
The dealer’s DMS / company portal files (stock, PO, receipts, transfers, in-transit, back orders) are exported and uploaded
Masters, upload settings, OOQ / SOQ rules, transfer and sister rules, output formats and notification rules (M002-M004, M009).
Selects ready locations, generates, checks flagged orders, edits and approves (M005). OGYS never sends without approval.
OGYS builds the order in each dealer’s format and hands it to the channels with the alerts set for that location (M006).
E-mail with the Excel order, plus WhatsApp / SMS alert; editable lines are left to the SPM’s decision.
CEO / GM / service GM get the order value so that payment can be arranged in time.
Excess at a sister or child location is moved by internal transfer (ITO / STN) before buying; ITO mail per location (M004).
Parts a co-dealer can supply (often at a better discount) are ordered from it before the company; they arrive as co-dealer in
The dealer SPM - not Sparecare - places the purchase order with the OEM. Sparecare suggests; the dealer buys.
On the feedback page the SPM marks lines placed, short, excess or not placed, with a predefined remark per line.
The OEM’s PO file is uploaded to confirm what was actually ordered; PO numbers are mapped to locations.
Shipped parts show as in transit (part of OOQ), then as received stock; the back order is served and the next run starts.
FS / BDM / ZBDM and OC / BM see their own dealer locations and chase pending data or orders (M010, next stage).
Dealer (Sparecare client) - one dealer, many locations
